---- MODULE W4Od5m1p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Players, Delta, MaxVer
ASSUME Delta \in Nat /\ MaxVer \in Nat
VARIABLES holder, record, version, contrib, staged

vars == <<holder, record, version, contrib, staged>>

RECURSIVE SumFn(_)
SumFn(S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
            ELSE LET p == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE
                 IN contrib[p] + SumFn(S \ {p})

Init ==
  /\ holder \in Players
  /\ record = 0
  /\ version = 0
  /\ contrib = [p \in Players |-> 0]
  /\ staged = [p \in Players |-> 0]

Stage(p) ==
  /\ holder = p
  /\ staged[p] = 0
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![p] = Delta]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, record, version, contrib>>

Commit(p) ==
  /\ holder = p
  /\ staged[p] > 0
  /\ record' = record + staged[p]
  /\ contrib' = [contrib EXCEPT ![p] = contrib[p] + staged[p]]
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ staged' = [staged EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED holder

Advance(p) ==
  /\ holder = p
  /\ staged[p] = 0
  /\ \E q \in Players : holder' = q
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, version, contrib, staged>>

AdminSeize ==
  /\ \E q \in Players : holder' = q
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, version, contrib, staged>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Players : Stage(p) \/ Commit(p) \/ Advance(p)
  \/ AdminSeize

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdates == record = SumFn(Players)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Players = {p1, p2, p3}
  Delta = 1
  MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdates
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby uses a matchmaker that circulates a single write token around a ring of players so that only one player may edit the shared lobby roster at any moment. The shared roster is represented by a running record value plus a version counter; each committed edit adds that player's own contribution to the record and bumps the version by one. A player may only stage and commit an edit while it currently holds the token; when it releases, the token advances to the next seat in the ring. Because the token serializes writers, an edit read-modify-writes the record without another writer interleaving, so no player's contribution can be silently overwritten by a concurrent writer. A privileged admin may seize the token from whoever holds it at any time, but the admin's seizure does not itself edit the record, it only reassigns who may write next. The record therefore always equals the sum of every contribution that has been committed so far.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared record value always equals the total of all player contributions that have been committed, so no committed update is ever lost.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m8p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Routers, MaxRouted
Zones == {"z1", "z2"}
Belts == {"b1", "b2", "b3", "b4"}
ParentZone == [b1 |-> "z1", b2 |-> "z1", b3 |-> "z2", b4 |-> "z2"]
ASSUME MaxRouted \in Nat
NoOne == "none"

VARIABLES zoneOwner, beltOwner, phase, routed
vars == <<zoneOwner, beltOwner, phase, routed>>

Init ==
  /\ zoneOwner = [z \in Zones |-> NoOne]
  /\ beltOwner = [b \in Belts |-> NoOne]
  /\ phase = [r \in Routers |-> "idle"]
  /\ routed = 0

AcquireCoarse(r, z) ==
  /\ phase[r] = "idle"
  /\ zoneOwner[z] = NoOne
  /\ zoneOwner' = [zoneOwner EXCEPT ![z] = r]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "coarse"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<beltOwner, routed>>

AcquireFine(r, b) ==
  /\ phase[r] = "coarse"
  /\ zoneOwner[ParentZone[b]] = r
  /\ beltOwner[b] = NoOne
  /\ beltOwner' = [beltOwner EXCEPT ![b] = r]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "fine"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<zoneOwner, routed>>

ReleaseFine(r, b) ==
  /\ phase[r] = "fine"
  /\ beltOwner[b] = r
  /\ beltOwner' = [beltOwner EXCEPT ![b] = NoOne]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "coarse"]
  /\ routed' = IF routed < MaxRouted THEN routed + 1 ELSE routed
  /\ UNCHANGED zoneOwner

ReleaseCoarse(r, z) ==
  /\ phase[r] = "coarse"
  /\ zoneOwner[z] = r
  /\ zoneOwner' = [zoneOwner EXCEPT ![z] = NoOne]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<beltOwner, routed>>

Next ==
  \E r \in Routers :
    \/ \E z \in Zones : AcquireCoarse(r, z) \/ ReleaseCoarse(r, z)
    \/ \E b \in Belts : AcquireFine(r, b) \/ ReleaseFine(r, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

FineImpliesCoarse ==
  \A b \in Belts :
    beltOwner[b] \in Routers => zoneOwner[ParentZone[b]] = beltOwner[b]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Routers = {A, B}
  MaxRouted = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FineImpliesCoarse
nl:
An airport baggage router controls conveyor belts that are grouped into zones. Two independent router instances, A and B, share one common pool of zones and belts. To service a belt, a router must first take the coarse lock on the belt's parent zone, and only then may it take the fine lock on the individual belt: this is hierarchical two-level locking. A zone lock may be held by at most one router at a time, and likewise a belt lock. A router progresses through phases: idle, then holding a zone (coarse), then holding a belt within that zone (fine). When it finishes it releases the belt, then the zone. A global counter records how many bags have been routed, one per belt release. The essential correctness condition is that a router may only hold a belt while it also holds that belt's parent zone, so a fine lock is never held without its covering coarse lock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a belt lock is held by a router, that same router also holds the coarse lock on the belt's parent zone.

---- MODULE W4Od11m8p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, MaxEpoch, MaxDone
ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxDone \in Nat
NoOne == "none"
Printers == {"pa", "pb"}
Trays == {"t1", "t2", "t3", "t4"}
Parent == [t1 |-> "pa", t2 |-> "pa", t3 |-> "pb", t4 |-> "pb"]

VARIABLES owner, tray, epoch, held, done
vars == <<owner, tray, epoch, held, done>>

Init ==
  /\ owner = [p \in Printers |-> NoOne]
  /\ tray = [t \in Trays |-> NoOne]
  /\ epoch = [p \in Printers |-> 0]
  /\ held = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
  /\ done = 0

Grant(w, p) ==
  /\ owner[p] = NoOne
  /\ \A q \in Printers : owner[q] # w
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![p] = w]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = epoch[p]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tray, epoch, done>>

Revoke(p) ==
  /\ owner[p] # NoOne
  /\ epoch[p] < MaxEpoch
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![p] = NoOne]
  /\ epoch' = [epoch EXCEPT ![p] = epoch[p] + 1]
  /\ tray' = [t \in Trays |-> IF Parent[t] = p THEN NoOne ELSE tray[t]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<held, done>>

Seize(w, t) ==
  /\ owner[Parent[t]] = w
  /\ held[w] = epoch[Parent[t]]
  /\ tray[t] = NoOne
  /\ tray' = [tray EXCEPT ![t] = w]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, held, done>>

Print(w, t) ==
  /\ tray[t] = w
  /\ owner[Parent[t]] = w
  /\ held[w] = epoch[Parent[t]]
  /\ done' = IF done < MaxDone THEN done + 1 ELSE done
  /\ tray' = [tray EXCEPT ![t] = NoOne]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, held>>

ReleaseP(w, p) ==
  /\ owner[p] = w
  /\ \A t \in Trays : (Parent[t] = p) => tray[t] = NoOne
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![p] = NoOne]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<tray, epoch, held, done>>

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : Grant(w, p) \/ ReleaseP(w, p)
  \/ \E p \in Printers : Revoke(p)
  \/ \E w \in Workers, t \in Trays : Seize(w, t) \/ Print(w, t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleHolder ==
  \A t \in Trays :
    tray[t] \in Workers =>
      /\ owner[Parent[t]] = tray[t]
      /\ held[tray[t]] = epoch[Parent[t]]
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Workers = {w1, w2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  MaxDone = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleHolder
nl:
A print shop spooler coordinates workers that print jobs on printers, where each printer contains several trays. Locking is hierarchical: a worker must first be granted ownership of a printer (the coarse resource) and only then may it seize one of that printer's trays (the fine resource) to print. Each printer carries an epoch number; when the spooler revokes a printer from its current owner it advances that printer's epoch and clears any tray the owner held, so a worker that was merely slow (never failed) but has fallen behind now carries a stale epoch. A worker records the epoch it believed current when granted. A worker may print on a tray only while it owns the tray's parent printer and its recorded epoch still equals the printer's current epoch. This prevents a stale or unauthorized worker, one whose grant has been superseded, from ever completing a print. A global counter tallies completed prints.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any worker that holds a tray also owns that tray's parent printer with a recorded epoch equal to the printer's current epoch, so no stale or unauthorized worker holds a tray.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m0p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Nodes, Requests
NoReq == "none"

VARIABLES version, door, snapReq, snapVer
vars == <<version, door, snapReq, snapVer>>

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ door = [r \in Requests |-> FALSE]
  /\ snapReq = [n \in Nodes |-> NoReq]
  /\ snapVer = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]

Acquire(n, r) ==
  /\ snapReq[n] = NoReq
  /\ door[r] = FALSE
  /\ snapReq' = [snapReq EXCEPT ![n] = r]
  /\ snapVer' = [snapVer EXCEPT ![n] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, door>>

Commit(n) ==
  /\ snapReq[n] # NoReq
  /\ snapVer[n] = version
  /\ door[snapReq[n]] = FALSE
  /\ door' = [door EXCEPT ![snapReq[n]] = TRUE]
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ snapReq' = [snapReq EXCEPT ![n] = NoReq]
  /\ snapVer' = [snapVer EXCEPT ![n] = 0]

Retry(n) ==
  /\ snapReq[n] # NoReq
  /\ snapVer[n] # version
  /\ snapReq' = [snapReq EXCEPT ![n] = NoReq]
  /\ snapVer' = [snapVer EXCEPT ![n] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, door>>

Abort(n) ==
  /\ snapReq[n] # NoReq
  /\ door[snapReq[n]] = TRUE
  /\ snapReq' = [snapReq EXCEPT ![n] = NoReq]
  /\ snapVer' = [snapVer EXCEPT ![n] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, door>>

Quiesce ==
  /\ \A r \in Requests : door[r] = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, r \in Requests : Acquire(n, r)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Commit(n) \/ Retry(n) \/ Abort(n)
  \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleOpen ==
  \A n \in Nodes :
    (snapReq[n] # NoReq /\ door[snapReq[n]] = TRUE) => snapVer[n] < version
====
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network processes unlock requests using optimistic concurrency control with retry. There is a shared authoritative version number. Each controller node, when it wants to apply an unlock request, first optimistically reads the current version into a private snapshot together with the request it intends to apply. To commit, the node performs a compare-and-set: it may finalize the unlock only if the version it snapshotted still equals the live version and the request has not already been applied. A successful commit physically opens that door (an irreversible action), advances the shared version by one, and clears the node's snapshot. If a node finds its snapshot version no longer matches the live version, it discards the snapshot and retries. If it notices its target request was already opened by someone else, it aborts. A controller may be slow but never crashes, so a lagging node can still be holding an old snapshot. Because a commit advances the version, any node still holding a snapshot for a request that has since been opened must be holding a version strictly older than the live one, so its stale compare-and-set can never succeed and no door is opened twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any node whose held snapshot targets a request whose door is already open must have snapshotted a version strictly older than the live version, so a stale request can never be committed a second time.

---- MODULE W4Od1m3p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Controllers, Flights, MaxLanded
ASSUME MaxLanded \in Nat
NoLeader == "none"
NoOwner == "free"

VARIABLES leader, alive, lockOwner, phase, landed
vars == <<leader, alive, lockOwner, phase, landed>>

Init ==
  /\ leader = NoLeader
  /\ alive = [c \in Controllers |-> TRUE]
  /\ lockOwner = NoOwner
  /\ phase = [f \in Flights |-> "idle"]
  /\ landed = 0

Elect(c) ==
  /\ alive[c] = TRUE
  /\ (leader = NoLeader \/ (leader # NoLeader /\ alive[leader] = FALSE))
  /\ leader' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, lockOwner, phase, landed>>

Crash(c) ==
  /\ alive[c] = TRUE
  /\ \A d \in Controllers : alive[d] = TRUE
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, lockOwner, phase, landed>>

Recover(c) ==
  /\ alive[c] = FALSE
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, lockOwner, phase, landed>>

Request(f) ==
  /\ phase[f] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "waiting"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, lockOwner, landed>>

Grant(f) ==
  /\ leader # NoLeader /\ alive[leader] = TRUE
  /\ lockOwner = NoOwner
  /\ phase[f] = "waiting"
  /\ lockOwner' = f
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "onRunway"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, landed>>

Leave(f) ==
  /\ phase[f] = "onRunway"
  /\ lockOwner = f
  /\ lockOwner' = NoOwner
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "done"]
  /\ landed' = IF landed < MaxLanded THEN landed + 1 ELSE landed
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive>>

Reset(f) ==
  /\ phase[f] = "done"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![f] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, lockOwner, landed>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Elect(c) \/ Crash(c) \/ Recover(c)
  \/ \E f \in Flights : Request(f) \/ Grant(f) \/ Leave(f) \/ Reset(f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

RunwayMutex ==
  \A f \in Flights : phase[f] = "onRunway" => lockOwner = f
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Controllers = {c1, c2}
  Flights = {f1, f2, f3}
  MaxLanded = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RunwayMutex
nl:
An air-traffic control system allocates a single shared runway to flights. A pool of controllers runs a leader-election protocol with failover: at any time at most one live controller is the elected leader, and only the leader may grant the runway. A controller may crash silently (without announcing it); to keep the tower operational at most one controller is down at a time, and a downed controller can later recover. When the current leader is not alive, any alive controller may take over as the new leader. Each flight moves through phases: idle, waiting for the runway, on the runway (the critical section), and done, after which it may reset to idle. The runway itself is a lock with a single owner. A waiting flight is put on the runway only by a live leader and only when the lock is free, which makes the flight the lock owner; when it leaves, the lock is freed and a landing is tallied. Because the lock has exactly one owner, two flights can never occupy the runway at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A flight is on the runway only while it is the sole owner of the runway lock, so no two flights are ever on the runway simultaneously.

---- MODULE W4Od12m8p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Techs, Delta, MaxStock
ASSUME Delta \in Nat /\ MaxStock \in Nat
Free == "free"

VARIABLES bankOwner, stockOwner, held, snap, stock
vars == <<bankOwner, stockOwner, held, snap, stock>>

Init ==
  /\ bankOwner = Free
  /\ stockOwner = Free
  /\ held = [w \in Techs |-> FALSE]
  /\ snap = [w \in Techs |-> 0]
  /\ stock = 0

TakeBank(w) ==
  /\ bankOwner = Free
  /\ bankOwner' = w
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stockOwner, held, snap, stock>>

TakeStock(w) ==
  /\ bankOwner = w
  /\ stockOwner = Free
  /\ held[w] = FALSE
  /\ stockOwner' = w
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = TRUE]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![w] = stock]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bankOwner, stock>>

Commit(w) ==
  /\ stockOwner = w
  /\ held[w] = TRUE
  /\ stock' = IF snap[w] + Delta <= MaxStock THEN snap[w] + Delta ELSE snap[w]
  /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = FALSE]
  /\ stockOwner' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED <<bankOwner, snap>>

ReleaseBank(w) ==
  /\ bankOwner = w
  /\ held[w] = FALSE
  /\ bankOwner' = Free
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stockOwner, held, snap, stock>>

AdminOverride ==
  /\ held' = [w \in Techs |-> FALSE]
  /\ bankOwner' = Free
  /\ stockOwner' = Free
  /\ stock' = IF stock + Delta <= MaxStock THEN stock + Delta ELSE stock
  /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next ==
  \/ \E w \in Techs : TakeBank(w) \/ TakeStock(w) \/ Commit(w) \/ ReleaseBank(w)
  \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SnapshotConsistent ==
  \A w \in Techs : (stockOwner = w /\ held[w] = TRUE) => snap[w] = stock
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Techs = {t1, t2}
  Delta = 2
  MaxStock = 6
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SnapshotConsistent
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker maintains a single shared stock count of units on hand. Technicians modify the stock with a hierarchical two-level lock: a technician must first take the coarse bank lock, then the fine stock lock, before it may read and write the stock. To perform an update, the holder of the stock lock first snapshots the current stock into its private register; it later commits by writing back its snapshot adjusted by a fixed delta, then releasing the stock lock. Because only the exclusive stock-lock holder can change the stock, a holder's snapshot stays equal to the live stock for the entire time it holds the lock, so no other update can slip in and be overwritten (no lost update). A privileged supervisor may override the whole protocol at any time: the override forcibly clears every technician's hold, frees both locks, and applies an adjustment itself. Stock is capped at a maximum capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: While a technician holds the stock lock, its snapshotted value always equals the live stock, so no concurrent update to the shared stock is ever lost.

---- MODULE W4Od4m2p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Stations, MaxCars
ASSUME MaxCars \in Nat

VARIABLES vote, decision, released, cars, phase
vars == <<vote, decision, released, cars, phase>>

Init ==
  /\ vote = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
  /\ decision = "none"
  /\ released = FALSE
  /\ cars = 0
  /\ phase = "voting"

Vote(s, v) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ vote[s] = "none"
  /\ v \in {"yes", "no"}
  /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![s] = v]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, released, cars, phase>>

DecideCommit ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ decision = "none"
  /\ \A s \in Stations : vote[s] = "yes"
  /\ decision' = "commit"
  /\ phase' = "decided"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, released, cars>>

DecideAbort ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ decision = "none"
  /\ \E s \in Stations : vote[s] = "no"
  /\ decision' = "abort"
  /\ phase' = "decided"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, released, cars>>

Release ==
  /\ phase = "decided"
  /\ decision = "commit"
  /\ released = FALSE
  /\ released' = TRUE
  /\ cars' = IF cars < MaxCars THEN cars + 1 ELSE cars
  /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, decision, phase>>

Reset ==
  /\ phase = "decided"
  /\ (decision = "abort" \/ released = TRUE)
  /\ vote' = [s \in Stations |-> "none"]
  /\ decision' = "none"
  /\ released' = FALSE
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ UNCHANGED cars

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Vote(s, "yes") \/ Vote(s, "no")
  \/ DecideCommit \/ DecideAbort \/ Release \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SafeRelease ==
  released = TRUE => (decision = "commit" /\ \A s \in Stations : vote[s] = "yes")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Stations = {soap, rinse, dry}
  MaxCars = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SafeRelease
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line releases each washed car to the street only after a two-phase commit across several stations (soap, rinse, dry). For one car at a time, a coordinator runs the protocol. In the voting phase each station casts a vote of yes or no at its own pace; a station may be slow but never fails, so votes trickle in asynchronously. Once votes are in, the coordinator decides: if every station voted yes it decides commit, and if any station voted no it decides abort. Releasing the car onto the street is the single irreversible action, and it may occur only after a commit decision, and only once. After a car is released or its transaction aborted, the line resets to start the next car, bounded by a maximum throughput count. The decision, once made for the current car, drives whether release is permitted.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A car is released only after the coordinator has decided commit with every station having voted yes, and it is released at most once per transaction.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m5p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Nodes, Proposals, Quorum
ASSUME Quorum \in Nat

VARIABLES votes, applied, ledger, load
vars == <<votes, applied, ledger, load>>

Init ==
  /\ votes = [p \in Proposals |-> {}]
  /\ applied = [p \in Proposals |-> FALSE]
  /\ ledger = {}
  /\ load = 0

CastVote(n, p) ==
  /\ n \notin votes[p]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = votes[p] \cup {n}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<applied, ledger, load>>

Apply(p) ==
  /\ applied[p] = FALSE
  /\ Cardinality(votes[p]) >= Quorum
  /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ ledger' = ledger \cup {p}
  /\ load' = load + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED votes

Restore(p) ==
  /\ applied[p] = TRUE
  /\ load > 0
  /\ load' = load - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, applied, ledger>>

Quiesce ==
  /\ \A p \in Proposals : applied[p] = TRUE
  /\ load = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes, p \in Proposals : CastVote(n, p)
  \/ \E p \in Proposals : Apply(p) \/ Restore(p)
  \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostShed ==
  \A p \in Proposals :
    applied[p] = TRUE => (p \in ledger /\ Cardinality(votes[p]) >= Quorum)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {a, b, c}
  Proposals = {p1, p2}
  Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostShed
nl:
A power-grid load shedder decides shed proposals by quorum voting. There is a fixed set of relay nodes, and each shed proposal must gather votes from a quorum (a majority) of nodes before it can be applied. Votes for a proposal accumulate in a set, so a node voting more than once or votes arriving out of order (messages can be reordered) has no extra effect. When a proposal has collected a quorum of votes, it is applied: the proposal is recorded into the shared shed ledger and the total shed load is increased. Applying is guarded so a proposal is applied at most once. The shared ledger is the authoritative record of which sheds took effect. The correctness requirement is that every applied proposal is faithfully present in the shared ledger and was backed by a genuine quorum, so no applied shed is ever lost from the record and none is applied without sufficient votes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every proposal marked applied is present in the shared shed ledger and had at least a quorum of votes, so no applied update is lost or unbacked.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m9p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Total, MaxEpoch
ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch \in Nat
Zones == {"z1", "z2", "z3"}

VARIABLES load, reserve, epoch, active
vars == <<load, reserve, epoch, active>>

Init ==
  /\ load = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
  /\ reserve = Total
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ active = [z \in Zones |-> TRUE]

Shed(z, e) ==
  /\ e = epoch
  /\ active[z] = TRUE
  /\ load[z] > 0
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![z] = load[z] - 1]
  /\ reserve' = reserve + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, active>>

Restore(z, e) ==
  /\ e = epoch
  /\ active[z] = TRUE
  /\ reserve > 0
  /\ reserve' = reserve - 1
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![z] = load[z] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, active>>

MoveLoad(z1, z2, e) ==
  /\ e = epoch
  /\ z1 # z2
  /\ active[z1] = TRUE /\ active[z2] = TRUE
  /\ load[z1] > 0
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![z1] = load[z1] - 1, ![z2] = load[z2] + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserve, epoch, active>>

Reconfigure(z) ==
  /\ epoch' = IF epoch < MaxEpoch THEN epoch + 1 ELSE epoch

When a pharmacist wants to fill a prescription it optimistically snapshots that prescription's current version. To fill (the single irreversible dispensing action) it performs a compare-and-set: it may proceed only if its snapshot version still equals the prescription's live version, the prescription is still open, and stock is available. EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Sectors, MaxVer
ASSUME MaxVer \in Nat
Free == "free"
NoSec == "nosec"

VARIABLES secOwner, secVer, snap, holding, active
vars == <<secOwner, secVer, snap, holding, active>>

Init ==
  /\ secOwner = [s \in Sectors |-> Free]
  /\ secVer = [s \in Sectors |-> 0]
  /\ snap = [d \in Drones |-> [sec |-> NoSec, ver |-> 0]]
  /\ holding = [d \in Drones |-> NoSec]
  /\ active = [s \in Sectors |-> TRUE]

Snapshot(d, s) ==
  /\ snap[d].sec = NoSec
  /\ holding[d] = NoSec
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = [sec |-> s, ver |-> secVer[s]]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<secOwner, secVer, holding, active>>

Claim(d) ==
  /\ snap[d].sec # NoSec
  /\ snap[d].ver = secVer[snap[d].sec]
  /\ secOwner[snap[d].sec] = Free
  /\ active[snap[d].sec] = TRUE
  /\ secVer[snap[d].sec] < MaxVer
  /\ secOwner' = [secOwner EXCEPT ![snap[d].sec] = d]
  /\ secVer' = [secVer EXCEPT ![snap[d].sec] = secVer[snap[d].sec] + 1]
  /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![d] = snap[d].sec]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = [sec |-> NoSec, ver |-> 0]]
  /\ UNCHANGED active

Retry(d) ==
  /\ snap[d].sec # NoSec
  /\ snap[d].ver # secVer[snap[d].sec]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = [sec |-> NoSec, ver |-> 0]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<secOwner, secVer, holding, active>>

Release(d) ==
  /\ holding[d] # NoSec
  /\ secOwner' = [secOwner EXCEPT ![holding[d]] = Free]
  /\ secVer' = [secVer EXCEPT ![holding[d]] = IF secVer[holding[d]] < MaxVer THEN secVer[holding[d]] + 1 ELSE secVer[holding[d]]]
  /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![d] = NoSec]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, active>>

SetActive(s, b) ==
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![s] = b]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<secOwner, secVer, snap, holding>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : Snapshot(d, s)
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Claim(d) \/ Retry(d) \/ Release(d)
  \/ \E s \in Sectors, b \in {TRUE, FALSE} : SetActive(s, b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SectorMutex ==
  \A d \in Drones : holding[d] # NoSec => secOwner[holding[d]] = d
====

CONSTANTS
  Drones = {d1, d2}
  Sectors = {s1, s2}
  MaxVer = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SectorMutex
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm assigns drones to sectors using optimistic concurrency control with retry, over a set of sectors whose availability changes at runtime. Each sector is a lock with a single owner and carries a version number. A drone that wants a sector first optimistically snapshots that sector's current version. To claim it, the drone performs a compare-and-set: it may take ownership only if its snapshot version still equals the sector's live version, the sector is currently free, and the sector is active. A successful claim makes the drone the sector's sole owner, records the sector as the drone's holding, and advances the sector's version. If the snapshot no longer matches the live version, the drone discards it and retries. Releasing a held sector frees the owner and advances the version. Sectors can be activated or deactivated at runtime to reflect changing coverage needs. Because each sector lock has a single owner, no two drones ever hold the same sector at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A drone holds a sector only while it is that sector's sole lock owner, so no two drones ever hold the same sector simultaneously.

---- MODULE W4Od10m1p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Nodes, Step, Ceiling
ASSUME Step \in Nat /\ Ceiling \in Nat

VARIABLES holder, record, snap, updating, inService
vars == <<holder, record, snap, updating, inService>>

Init ==
  /\ holder \in Nodes
  /\ record = 0
  /\ snap = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
  /\ updating = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
  /\ inService = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]

TakeSnapshot(n) ==
  /\ holder = n
  /\ inService[n] = TRUE
  /\ updating[n] = FALSE
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![n] = record]
  /\ updating' = [updating EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, record, inService>>

Commit(n) ==
  /\ holder = n
  /\ updating[n] = TRUE
  /\ record' = IF snap[n] + Step <= Ceiling THEN snap[n] + Step ELSE snap[n]
  /\ updating' = [updating EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, snap, inService>>

PassToken(n) ==
  /\ updating[holder] = FALSE
  /\ inService[n] = TRUE
  /\ holder' = n
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, snap, updating, inService>>

Enlist(n) ==
  /\ inService[n] = FALSE
  /\ inService' = [inService EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, record, snap, updating>>

Retire(n) ==
  /\ inService[n] = TRUE
  /\ holder # n
  /\ Cardinality({m \in Nodes : inService[m]}) > 1
  /\ inService' = [inService EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, record, snap, updating>>

Next ==
  \E n \in Nodes :
    TakeSnapshot(n) \/ Commit(n) \/ PassToken(n) \/ Enlist(n) \/ Retire(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SnapshotConsistent ==
  \A n \in Nodes : (holder = n /\ updating[n] = TRUE) => snap[n] = record
====

CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
  Step = 2
  Ceiling = 6
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SnapshotConsistent
nl:
A subway signalling block system maintains a single shared schedule record that dispatch nodes update one at a time. Exclusive write authority circulates as a single token in a ring, and only the current token holder may modify the schedule record. To perform an update, the token holder first snapshots the current schedule value into its private register, then commits by writing back its snapshot increased by a fixed step, up to a capacity ceiling, and then clears its snapshot. Because only the exclusive token holder can change the record, and it holds the token for the whole read-modify-write, its snapshot stays equal to the live record the entire time it is mid-update, so no other node's update can slip in and be overwritten (no lost update). The token may be passed to any node that is currently in service. Nodes can be brought into service or taken out of service at runtime as the line's capacity changes, but at least one node always remains in service, and the token is only ever passed to an in-service node.
SAFETY PROPERTY: While a node is mid-update holding a snapshot, its snapshot always equals the live schedule record, so no concurrent update to the shared record is ever lost.
